name: gitea
label: Gitea / Forgejo
description: Self-hosted git forge: find issues and pull requests, read them, comment, label and close.

search_issues.doc: find issues and pull requests across repositories; params: state, assigned, type (issues|pulls), q, limit

get_issue.doc: read one issue or pull request; params: owner, repo, index

list_comments.doc: read the discussion; params: owner, repo, index

comment.doc: write a comment; params: owner, repo, index, body

create_issue.doc: file an issue; params: owner, repo, title, body

update_issue.doc: change state, labels or assignees; params: owner, repo, index, state (open|closed), labels, assignees

list_pull_files.doc: see what a pull request changes; params: owner, repo, index

prompt_doc:
Gitea (and Forgejo, which speaks the same API) is your git forge. The base URL and the token come from the platform — you never see them.

search_issues finds work across every repository you can reach; get_issue and list_comments give you the case itself. Read the discussion before you answer it: a comment that repeats what somebody already said costs a person their time.
